changes: ACC weighted SW albedo mapping shares the existing scalar explicit-array helper.
ACC gas coefficient setup separates independent layers from ordered tropopause counts, adapting the tiled ACC donor.
ACC surface aggregation bounds each band's ordered g-point scan, including interleaved maps and empty bands.
Avoid touching unused host tile pages; preserve pressure-ordering checks and bounded device scratch.
NVHPC ACC scatters outputs on device, with pitched downloads per bounded tile or once per resident model step.
Optional driver-owned ACC model-source residency matches the corresponding base; all input refreshes and output downloads remain inside iteration timing.
Block-ordered seed/pressure staging removes repeated integer division while preserving original logical-block seeds.
Native MIX initialization uses an exactly equivalent branch-free Galois shift, preserving its random streams.
priority: Unified branch versus the corresponding numerically valid base; GPU/CPU throughput is secondary

protocol.physical_resources: 64 CPU cores/64 threads or two distinct A100-SXM4-40GB GPUs; 16960 columns, 137 levels
protocol.timing: Synchronized radiation iterations include required transfers and gather/scatter; exclude initialization, process launch and NetCDF I/O
protocol.memory: Maximum across groups of summed process RSS peaks and 20-ms-sampled NVML device peaks, including context/reservations; rank peaks need not be simultaneous
protocol.acc_source_lifetime: Default bounded source staging, or ECRAD_ACC_RESIDENT_FIELDS=1 for driver-owned full-model input residency matching the tiled ACC base. Resident mode still refreshes inputs inside every timed iteration; its model storage scales with ncol while radiation scratch remains tile-bounded.

statistics: Five independent paired process groups; exact one-sided sign-flip test on log times, p<0.05. No resolved slowdown does not prove equivalence. Inner iterations are not independent samples.
limits: OMP tiled comparison uses its valid equivalent-width unbatched control; the original packed fork fails numerical validation and is excluded.
Native CPU/GPU samplers differ. The existing full-domain matched-CPU/GPU LW tolerance miss remains separate; exact GPU/base agreement does not establish full-domain CPU/GPU agreement.
Results cover SP RRTMG/McICA, one input and the tested hardware; SP/DP correctness checks are separate.
rejected_trials: A full g-point scan per output band did not improve whole-iteration time; retain bounded band scans.
An explicit-shape dense-only wrapper added complexity without a measurable timing improvement and was removed.
256-lane SW launches and a 32-lane source gather regressed performance; retain the original launch policy.
Explicit CUDA host registration failed during cleanup; its code and CUDA link option were removed.
CPU scratch-interface and vector-cosine trials did not consistently improve timings and were removed.
A floating MINSTD reduction preserved test streams but did not affect the default MIX path; it was removed.

checks.python_syntax_and_paired_statistics: Passed; synthetic identical/faster/slower five-pair cases checked
checks.fortran_added_line_quick_check: Seven S1 END DO/END IF spelling findings follow radiation/CONVENTIONS; no other findings
checks.fortls: Attempted on changed Fortran sources; launcher exits 1 without diagnostics

reproduction.environment: module load cmake ninja prgenv/nvidia nvidia/24.5 netcdf4 python3
reproduction.build: python3 test/ifs/benchmark_gpu_build.py main-cpu optimized-cpu acc-opt acc-tiled master-omp omp-tiled optimized-acc optimized-omp
reproduction.acc_tiled: sbatch test/ifs/benchmark_gpu.sbatch matrix-acc cpu tiled32 tiled64 tiled128
reproduction.acc_tiled_resident: sbatch --export=ALL,ECRAD_ACC_RESIDENT_FIELDS=1 test/ifs/benchmark_gpu.sbatch matrix-acc cpu tiled32 tiled64 tiled128
reproduction.omp: sbatch --time=00:25:00 test/ifs/benchmark_gpu.sbatch matrix-omp cpu normal tiled32 tiled64 tiled128
reproduction.report: python3 test/ifs/benchmark_gpu_matrix_report.py ACC_TILED_JOB ACC_NORMAL_JOB OMP_JOB OUTPUT.json
reproduction.candidate_builds: These allocations used isolated candidate-acc/candidate-omp build directories to keep earlier measurements immutable; rebuilding optimized-acc/optimized-omp from this source uses the same flags.

validation.saved_output_scope: All saved numerical variables in active columns; inactive offset-driver outputs are unspecified and excluded
validation.precision_test_fix: Give the MINSTD test a private module directory and assert the expected PARKIND1 precision; NVHPC otherwise imported the SP module into the DP test
validation.large_input_cpu_gpu_limitation: The inherited 0.003814697265625 W/m2 LW GPU/matched-CPU discrepancy exceeds the unchanged 0.001 threshold; valid GPU bases share it. Tolerances were not relaxed.

bounded_source_mode.interpretation: Bounded mode releases each mapped source run before radiation scratch; comparison is against the fork's resident-source mode, so ownership strategies differ.

native_cpu_validation.stream_scope: 1000 seeds including signed boundaries; uniform chunks spanning buffer boundaries and Gaussian draws, compared against frozen pre-change executables
native_cpu_validation.interpretation: The branch-free initializer preserves the existing generator and random streams; it does not switch the CPU sampler.
